description: This file defines a data access object (DAO) interface for ProfileEntity using Room persistence library in Kotlin. It provides methods for querying, inserting, and deleting profile records in a local database.

classes.name: ProfileDao
classes.description: Data access object interface for handling profile entities in the database.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Observes all profiles as a Flow, emitted in descending order of id.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a profile entity in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a profile entity from the database.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a profile by its id.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a profile entity by its id.

calls: Query('SELECT * FROM profiles ORDER BY id DESC')
